# scan for board bounding box

for y in range(H):
    for x in range(W):

            if x<minx:minx=x
            if x>maxx:maxx=x
            if y<miny:miny=y
            if y>maxy:maxy=y

python3 - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
S=80
def sq(name):
    f=ord(name[0])-97; r=int(name[1]); y=(8-r)*S; x=f*S
    return im.crop((x,y,x+S,y+S)).resize((240,240), Image.NEAREST)
# combine crops into one grid: f5,d8,e2,c1,e1,c6,d5,c8,g5
names=['f5','d8','e2','c1','e1','c6','d5','c8','g5']
out=Image.new('RGB',(240*3,240*3),(255,255,255))
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    out.paste(sq(n),((i%3)*240,(i//3)*240))
out.save('crops.png')
print(names)
EOF
